knobs.note: Read by bin/lane-reprobe.sh as ${LANE_REPROBE_FAST_S:-1800}: seconds between probes of a runner lane marked down in state/lane-down/ while its outage is younger than LANE_REPROBE_BACKOFF_AFTER_S; a non-numeric value falls back to 1800. Registered by BH-1687, the change that introduced the read; no reviewed min/max yet, so nothing is clamped.

Read by bin/lane-reprobe.sh as ${LANE_REPROBE_SLOW_S:-21600}: seconds between probes once the outage is LANE_REPROBE_BACKOFF_AFTER_S old, and the interval the standing warn quotes; a non-numeric value falls back to 21600. Registered by BH-1687, the change that introduced the read; no reviewed min/max yet, so nothing is clamped.

Read by bin/lane-reprobe.sh as ${LANE_REPROBE_BACKOFF_AFTER_S:-86400}: outage age in seconds at which a down lane moves from the fast to the slow probe interval; a non-numeric value falls back to 86400. Registered by BH-1687, the change that introduced the read; no reviewed min/max yet, so nothing is clamped.

Read by bin/lane-reprobe.sh as ${LANE_DOWN_STANDING_S:-86400}: outage age in seconds at which a still-down lane raises its ONE standing warn, lanedown-stale-<box>-<lane>, per outage; a non-numeric value falls back to 86400. Registered by BH-1687, the change that introduced the read; no reviewed min/max yet, so nothing is clamped.

Read by bin/lane-reprobe.sh as ${LANE_REPROBE_MAX_PER_RUN:-4}: the most lanes one tick probes, oldest last_probe first; the rest are logged as deferred and wait for the next tick; a non-numeric value falls back to 4. Registered by BH-1687, the change that introduced the read; no reviewed min/max yet, so nothing is clamped.

Read by bin/lane-reprobe.sh as ${LANE_REPROBE_DEADLINE_S:-600}: seconds after the tick starts past which no further probe is started; the rest are logged as deferred; a non-numeric value falls back to 600. Registered by BH-1687, the change that introduced the read; no reviewed min/max yet, so nothing is clamped.

Read by bin/lane-reprobe.sh (through ld_mark in bin/lib/lane-down.sh) as ${LANE_DOWN_TTL_S:-7200}: seconds a fleet `lane` row (bin/lib/fleet-cooldown.sh) stays live after a mark; every mark refreshes it; a non-numeric or 0 value falls back to 7200. Registered by BH-2359, the change that introduced the read; no reviewed min/max yet, so nothing is clamped.
